ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity black pixels (fluke body) to high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the distal tips and lower splash zone.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark distribution across the central and medial lobe areas; localized high-intensity pixel clusters are mapped specifically to the far-left and far-right distal tips and the irregular lower boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center with a defined vertex and symmetrical slopes forming an internal angle of approximately 100 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration across the continuous trailing edge boundary, characterized by jagged peaks and steep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature extending from the central notch toward the distal tips, with convex outer lateral edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal-most points of both the left and right lobes, forming jagged textured protrusions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified-appearing clusters at both terminal tips of the fluke; scattered circular high-intensity markings on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct ring-shaped white pixel formations on the left ventral surface mid-lobe region.
